{{Quote|Another day, another patrol.|Fghai'g Windrunner|<ref name="SWG:APR" />}}
'''Fghai'g Windrunner''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] who lived in the [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo system]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|But then again, these Penumbra Omen folks... they sound pretty interesting. Quadrant "Penumbra Omen", huh? Might want to check it out.|Fghai'g Windrunner|<ref name="SWG:APR" />}}
Around the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Fghai'g Windrunner visited the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] where he bought [[Comm scanner|communication scanner]] to a [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] [[Merchant/Legends|trader]] for his own amusement. The pilot later used the device during a patrol mission in the Naboo system and intercepted an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] emergency report. The communication reported the destruction of an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] unit commander by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Silverline]], an [[Imperial Authoritarian]], in the [[Area D-512]] of the Naboo system by an mysterious and hostile force, code-named [[Penumbra Omen]]. Captain Silverline reported that the unidentified assailant starships were probably piloted by [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and were led by an individual identified as [[OT-Violator]]. Although the Empire advised to avoid the area, Fghai'g Windrunner considered to explore the Area D-512 to investigate the Penumbra Omen.<ref name="SWG:APR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Fghai'g Windrunner was mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:APR" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The document mentioning Fghai'g Windrunner was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]].<ref name="SWG:APR" />
